standings.title: Standings
standings.note: Report data unavailable; refresh from MFL to fill this report. MFL's tiebreak order is not held, so ties keep MFL's franchise order; refresh from MFL.
standings.how: Records count regular-season games by MFL's result; a tie counts half a win in win percentage. Points for counts every week MFL scored, playoff weeks included, as MFL's own standings do; points against counts regular-season games. Games back trail the division leader: a win and a loss are one game apart. Each division is in the league's tiebreak order (Tiebreakers shows each step).

reports.title: Projected playoff seeding
reports.note: Report data unavailable; refresh from MFL to fill this report.
reports.how: If the regular season ended today: each division leader is seeded first, in the league's tiebreak order, then the best of the rest as wild cards, until each conference's bracket is full. The opening round follows the bracket's size: the top seeds sit out, and the rest meet highest seed against lowest.

reports.title: On the bubble
reports.note: Report data unavailable; refresh from MFL to fill this report.
reports.how: The wild-card holders and every franchise that can still catch its conference's last seed: one that trails it by no more games than it has left. Games back: a win and a loss are one game apart. A team level on games back trails on the tiebreak order.

reports.title: Tiebreakers
reports.note: Report data unavailable; refresh from MFL to fill this report. MFL's tiebreak order is not held, so ties keep MFL's franchise order; refresh from MFL.
reports.how: The league's own tiebreak order from MFL, applied to today's ties step by step. When a step separates some teams but leaves others level, those still level start again from the first tiebreak. Head-to-head counts only when every tied team has played every other; division and conference percentage count only when all the tied teams share that division or conference. All-play and points for count every week MFL scored.

reports.title: Playoff brackets
reports.note: Report data unavailable; refresh from MFL to fill this report.
reports.how: Every bracket the league defines on MFL, game by game, with MFL's seeds and scores. A side not yet known shows the seed or the earlier game it comes from. The winner is MFL's result for that week's game.

reports.title: All-play
reports.note: Report data unavailable; refresh from MFL to fill this report.
reports.how: Each week, every franchise's score is compared with every other franchise's score that week: higher is an all-play win, lower a loss, equal a tie. Every week MFL scored counts, playoff weeks included, as MFL's own all-play does. Wins against all-play pace are actual regular-season wins minus the wins the all-play percentage gives over the same games. Every bar runs from 0 to 1.

reports.title: Weekly points
reports.note: Report data unavailable; refresh from MFL to fill this report.
reports.how: Each franchise's score in every week MFL scored, most points first. All bars share one scale, from zero to the highest score any franchise posted in a week, so they compare down the column.

reports.title: Starter points by position
reports.note: Report data unavailable; refresh from MFL to fill this report.
reports.how: Points scored by each franchise's starters, by position, in every week MFL scored. Bench points do not count, and neither do the home-field points MFL adds in playoff games, so a playoff host's total sits just under its points for. Most starter points first.

reports.title: Starter points by player
reports.note: Report data unavailable; refresh from MFL to fill this report.
reports.how: Every player the franchise started in a week MFL scored, with his points in those starts. Bench weeks do not count. Most points first.

reports.title: Lineup detail
reports.note: Report data unavailable; refresh from MFL to fill this report.
